draft.title: Driveway and Walkway Cleaning & Sealing
draft.summary: Pressure washing of front driveway and entry walkway including target oil spot treatment, with an option to apply penetrating concrete sealer.
observations: Driveway is concrete, approximately two car widths wide, displaying moderate surface dirt and tire tracking.
A distinct dark oil stain is centered near the middle expansion joint of the driveway.
Concrete walkway leads from the driveway to the front entry door with light soil and organic buildup.

measurements.name: Driveway Area
measurements.how: Scaled from standard 16 ft double garage door; driveway is approx 18 ft wide by 35 ft long across 3 concrete panel sections

measurements.name: Front Walkway Area
measurements.how: Counted 5 standard walkway panel sections approx 3 ft wide by 4 ft long each

tiers.name: Pressure Wash Only
tiers.summary: Complete pressure washing of driveway and walkway, including targeted oil spot pre-treatment.

tiers.name: Wash & Seal
tiers.summary: Pressure wash driveway and walkway, treat oil stain, and apply a penetrating concrete sealer to protect against future stains.

items.detail: Apply heavy-duty commercial degreaser to oil stain near center joint, scrub, and allow dwell time prior to washing.
items.basis: Single oil spot spot-treatment area visible in center driveway.

items.description: Pressure wash concrete driveway and walkway
items.detail: Surface clean 700 sq ft of flat concrete surfaces using high-pressure surface cleaner and wand edging.
items.basis: Combined surface area of driveway (630 sq ft) and walkway (70 sq ft).

items.detail: Apply commercial penetrating water and oil repellent sealer to dry concrete surface to prevent future staining.
items.basis: Coverage for 700 sq ft concrete surface requiring approximately 4 gallons of sealer.

assumptions.text: An operational exterior hose bib with adequate water supply is accessible on site.
Oil stain pre-treatment will significantly lighten stain, but total 100% removal on aged porous concrete cannot be guaranteed.
Sealer application requires a 24-hour dry period post-washing before application.

exclusions: Concrete cracking or spalling structural repairs
House exterior siding, roof, or garage door pressure washing
Street curb or apron cleaning beyond driveway boundary
draft.customer_message: Thank you for reaching out. We have prepared an estimate to pressure wash your driveway and walkway, including special pre-treatment for the oil stain near the center. We also included a recommended option to seal the concrete afterward to protect against future oil drips and weathering.
draft.confidence_note: Scope and measurements are clearly defined from photo references.
